theorem.source_fact: CUT(H)=MET(H) iff H has no K5 minor.
theorem.janus_graph_fact: After equality contraction each clause contributes its boundary triangle; arbitrary JANUS instances can contain K4 in the Boolean-quadric interaction graph, hence K5 in the suspension.
theorem.conclusion: DIRECT CYCLE/METRIC RELAXATION IS NOT UNIVERSALLY EXACT.
